availability.note: Build & Price (page-data) lists Electric > Luxury with driveAwayPrice 38990; model marketed as 'Forthing Electric' since Sept 2026 trademark dispute

listPrice.note: Only a manufacturer recommended drive-away price exists ($38,990, dealerDeliveryFee 0 in configurator data; CarExpert table also says drive-away). (38990 - 958.80) / 1.042 = 36,498; round-trip through calc/onroad.js driveAwayPrice = 38990.11. No independent on-road estimate found to verify against; unchanged from held back-out. Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 36,574 at $880; round trip 38989.72).

batteryKwh.note: EVDB NZ: usable 64.4, gross (nominal) 67* (asterisk unexplained). Forthing AU Oct 2026 spec sheet gives 'Battery capacity (kWh) 64.4' unlabelled.

rangeKm.note: Forthing-Electric-SpecSheet-October2026.pdf: 'Electric Driving range: WLTP Up to 427km', 235/55 R19 on both grades. NZ quotes 400km WLTP for a 240Nm motor variant; the AU car is 150kW/340Nm, matching the 204hp/340Nm Forthing Friday listed at 425km WLTP (auto-data.net, lead only), so 427 is not treated as an NEDC submission (that variant's NEDC is listed at 480km).

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Forthing (NZ) claimed combined 15.5kWh/100km quoted by Driven, 19-inch 235/55 wheels. Same 15.5 WLTP listed for the 204hp/340Nm Friday on auto-data.net (lead). No AU claim published. 2.8% from 64.4/427. CarExpert tested 14.1-15.0 indicated.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: CarExpert: 'Forthing quotes 480L' seats up, excluding underfloor storage; the 541L previously held is a JATO figure (also used by NZ outlets). Measurement method not stated.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert: Forthing quotes 1480L seats folded; AA NZ also 1480. Method not stated.

towKg.note: Oct 2026 spec sheet: 'Towing Capacity - Braked and Unbraked (kg) 750' (REEV sheet identical). EV Central review also lists 750kg. Held 1500 came from the launch-era sheet / JATO; NZ outlets still quote 1.5t.

warrantyYears.note: 7yr/200,000km comprehensive, no servicing condition stated; battery 8yr/200,000km, 70% capacity

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to gac-aion-v-premium (1650), geely-ex5-complete (1600) and chery-e5; Luxury sits $3,000-5,000 below them in list price

depreciationCurve.note: One curve for all Forthing rows. Steeper than mainstream default: new brand with no resale history, thin dealer network, drive-away-only pricing with stock campaigns ($2,500 gift card Nov-Dec 2026) and a possible forced rename. Matches gac-aion-v (comparable new-to-market Chinese brand).
